title: Add random Skill in certain State

posts.author: dmad99
posts.body:
How to add random skill when at certain state. Yes i can add skill not randomly in state traits. But i want to add skill randomly at every turn to make it rng.
Is there any way to add skill randomly using script at certain state?
I Use rpg maker mv and Yanfly Free.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body: Make a state for each skill, and instead of a random skill, apply a random state when you apply the state.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
it can't be done by script alone.
you'll need a plugin to change how states are handled to give the engine the ability of executing a state notetag on apply, and then place the effects you want as script code into the notetag of the state.
